shorts.title: Polar Bears Almost Vanish on a Thermal Camera
shorts.hook: Point a thermal camera at a polar bear and it almost disappears.
shorts.outro: The nose on Doug's screen kept getting closer. How close it got is in the full video below.
shorts.end_card: HOW CLOSE DID THAT NOSE GET?
shorts.description: A polar bear's coat is nearly as cold as the snow, so infrared sees little more than its face; find out how close that nose got to Doug in the full episode.

shorts.title: This Polar Bear Held Its Breath 3 Minutes and Still Missed
shorts.outro: So Doug dressed as a seal and lay on a floe edge, right where the bear comes up. Full video below.
shorts.end_card: DID THE BEAR MISS DOUG TOO?
shorts.description: A Svalbard polar bear swam an Olympic pool's length underwater to stalk three seals and missed them all; see whether Doug, dressed as a seal, gets that lucky in the full episode.

shorts.title: Canada Has a Polar Bear Jail, and It Serves No Food
shorts.hook: Canada has a jail for polar bears. Nobody feeds the prisoners.
shorts.outro: Doug took the rubbish out in that same town, and something was waiting in the stairwell. Where Doug ended up is in the full video below.
shorts.description: Churchill, Canada locks problem polar bears in a holding facility with air-conditioned cells and no food; find out where Doug ended up in the full episode.
